title: Did any girls have this dream when they were roughly in freshman year of high school, about a decade ago?
content: I had this dream when I was in freshman year of high school. I was in a small room, maybe 20x20 feet, with the door open where I could see a hallway to other similar rooms outside. If any of you have been in a small group room at church, it was basically one of those. I was sitting in a chair, and there were other girls my age sitting in their own chairs, all aligned in a circle to face each other. There were roughly 10 of us. We weren't talking or anything for a little while, but then something in me realized that I was dreaming. I informed the other girls that this was a dream, and they were surprised. We started talking about the dream, and soon I suggested to them: "What if we're all asleep right now and sharing the same dream?" The girls got even more excited at that idea. When I woke up, I remember that I had recognized two of the girls in my dream, but by the time I woke up I could only recall one of them. Luckily I shared a class with her that day and I asked her if she had had a dream like this last night. She told me that she didn't. I was pretty disappointed. Hypothetically, it's possible that maybe she was the type of person to not remember her dreams when she woke up, but I feel like that could just be me being hopeful. Did anyone else have this dream? I know it was nearly a decade ago, but maybe it truly was a shared dream?
